description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'generateResponse' that interacts with an external AI API (Mistral AI) to generate chat responses based on user input. It constructs a request with a system prompt and user message, handles the API response, and manages errors.
external_files: fetch API (built-in in browsers or via polyfill in Node.js)

methods.name: generateResponse
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to the Mistral AI chat completion API and returns the generated response as a string.
